mechanism_not_run: Entity-owned OSM entrance node plus posed-panorama horizontal ray, authorized only when the camera-to-entrance segment reaches the target entrance before any target-self or non-target building occlusion.

initial_source_audit.outcome: The four preregistered direct panoramas did not permit marker-blind entity-plus-portal truth to be uniquely frozen. This is NOT_EVALUABLE, not an algorithm miss.

marker_blind_second_adjudication.reason: The arched glass hall contains multiple walkable door leaves/openings and a separate visible side door, so a unique target portal cannot be frozen from pixels alone.

stop_rule: The frozen confirmation required four independently evaluable direct portals. A 3/4 source is not converted to 3/3, R01 is not deleted after disagreement, no reserve is selected after seeing a projection, and no marker-visible adjudication is allowed.
legal_successor: Keep the entity-owned entrance and explicit occlusion representation unchanged, but change the posed-panorama provider to a separately audited Panoramax source whose public HD panoramas expose unique marker-blind portal truth. Reopen only after the raw-pixel orientation contract is independently fixed.
claim_boundary: This is a Mapillary source-admission failure before any PB19 projection or formal evaluator run. It is not evidence that the entrance-ray algorithm misses, succeeds, navigates, establishes public access or traversability, reaches the entrance, authorizes HANDOFF_READY, improves a product, benefits users, or is safe.
